limits: Exact symbolic identities and finite witnesses only; not formal certification of analytic compactness, PDE existence, cited uniqueness theorems or stochastic convergence.

mathematical_scope.deterministic_and_microscopic_limits: Invariant rectangle needs specified initial entropy terms; weighted Riccati bound needs positive gap; physical-viscosity mixed derivative prevents that maximum-principle shortcut; fixed-ring event has positive probability for sigma>0 but no uniform hydrodynamic probability; natural order non-attractiveness does not rule out all orders.
mathematical_scope.face_theorem: Conditional bounded D-valued weak Cauchy solution with prescribed bounded initial data, interior generalized convex Lax entropy inequalities, and global membership of solution and initial data in one specified face. Both Riemann invariants have sharp common upper coefficient 1/2; a constant invariant has zero slope.
mathematical_scope.general_limits: No general three-state Oleinik bound, hydrodynamic convergence, initial system entropy trace from weak empirical data, unconditional uniqueness or semigroup membership.
mathematical_scope.kernel_correction: Finite-scale source kernel integral normalization need not equal discrete normalization; use W_epsilon, uniform ||K_prime||_1/ell error, normalized profiles and strong local L1 limits.
mathematical_scope.trace_audit: Only inspected arXiv:math/0304481v2; no claim about an independently inspected journal proof, PDE counterexample or hydrodynamic counterexample.
